tworek.en: Pre-training plus RL is the core formula; RLHF was crucial to unlock GPT-4's potential.
tworek.zh: 预训练加强化学习是核心公式；基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）对释放 GPT-4 的潜力至关重要。

tworek.en: Scaling RL is harder than scaling pre-training; alignment is a never-ending pursuit.
tworek.zh: 扩展强化学习比扩展预训练更难；对齐是一个永无止境的追求。

tworek.en: Scaling RL alone may not lead to AGI; continual learning and self-correction are missing pieces.
tworek.zh: 仅靠扩展强化学习可能无法实现 AGI；持续学习和自我纠错是缺失的关键环节。

tworek.en: Architecture, not scaling laws, is the key bottleneck; Transformers cannot achieve continual learning.
tworek.zh: 架构而非缩放定律是主要瓶颈；Transformer 无法实现持续学习。

tworek.en: RL is not the ultimate learning method; better algorithms and end-to-end optimization will emerge.
tworek.zh: 强化学习并非终极学习方法；更好的算法和端到端优化将会出现。

joonpark.en: Initially, LLMs can simulate human behavior from training data, but frontier models optimized for rationality are not ideal for simulating irrational human behavior.
joonpark.zh: 最初，LLM 能从训练数据中模拟人类行为，但为理性优化的前沿模型并不适合模拟非理性的人类行为。

joonpark.en: Agents are the next frontier, acting on the world, but safety requires defense in depth; AGI may be a distributed society of specialized agents, not a single entity.
joonpark.zh: 智能体是下一个前沿，能作用于世界，但安全需要纵深防御；AGI 可能是一个由专业智能体组成的分布式社会，而非单一实体。

joonpark.en: Simulation should model human values and preferences, not super-rational intelligence; the goal is shaping the future, not just prediction.
joonpark.zh: 模拟应建模人类的价值观和偏好，而非超级理性智能；目标是塑造未来，而不仅仅是预测。

joonpark.en: Synthetic panels will surpass human panels in size within three years; a single simulation session could cost $100 million.
joonpark.zh: 合成面板将在三年内超越人类面板的规模；一次模拟会话可能耗资 1 亿美元。

awang.en: Data is the key bottleneck for AI; AGI is far off; AI will augment jobs, not replace them.
awang.zh: 2019 年，他认为数据是 AI 的关键瓶颈，AGI 还很遥远，AI 将增强而非取代工作。

awang.en: Data is the new code, not oil; post-training with expert data is the limiting factor; AI will be the greatest economic engine.
awang.zh: 2023 年，他提出数据是新代码而非石油，后训练中专家数据是限制因素，AI 将成为最伟大的经济引擎。

awang.en: Post-training with specialized data is key; synthetic data is not a silver bullet; US and Chinese labs have no research gap.
awang.zh: 2024 年，他强调专用数据的后训练是关键，合成数据并非万能，中美实验室无研究差距。

awang.en: AI is centralizing power; data is raw material; humans must stay sovereign; brain-computer interfaces needed for relevance.
awang.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AI 是集权技术，数据是原材料，人类必须保持主权，脑机接口是保持相关性的必需。

awang.en: Recursive self-improvement is new paradigm; agents work; superintelligence imminent; open-sourcing powerful models unsafe.
awang.zh: 2026 年，他提出递归自我改进是新范式，智能体已实用，超级智能临近，开源强大模型不安全。

jeffdean.en: Scaling compute, data, and model size drives progress; algorithmic gains multiply with scale. Near-term worry is misinformation, not superintelligence.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年初，Jeff Dean 强调 Scaling（规模扩张）在算力、数据和模型规模上持续驱动进步，算法改进与规模相乘。他更担忧 AI 生成媒体的虚假信息，而非超级智能。

jeffdean.en: Agentic systems need ultra-low-latency inference; pre-training should interleave action-taking. Inference now dominates data center power.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年 4 月，他指出智能体式系统需要超低延迟推理，预训练应穿插环境中的行动，而非仅被动预测下一个词。推理已占数据中心功耗 90%。

jeffdean.en: AI reaches junior-engineer coding; next is automating ML/science. Inference is bottleneck; custom low-precision chips cut latency 20-30x.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他认为 AI 已具备初级工程师编码能力，下一步是自动化 ML 与科学。推理是瓶颈，定制低精度芯片可降低延迟 20-30 倍。

mengto.en: AI enables solo builders to replace teams; start before ready, focus on one problem, and model success.
mengto.zh: 2026 年，AI 让单打独斗者能替代团队；强调先行动而非等待完美，聚焦单一问题，并模仿成功者。

mengto.en: Designers must build custom AI tools; use screenshots and design.md for style, and be editors not creators.
mengto.zh: 2026 年，设计师需自建 AI 工具，以截图和 design.md 定义风格，扮演编辑而非从零创造。

mengto.en: AI isn't smarter; you need giant prompts with context and design systems to unlock superintelligent models.
mengto.zh: 2026 年，AI 并未变聪明，需用包含上下文和设计系统的巨型提示词才能解锁超级智能模型。

mengto.en: Avoid AI slop by not chasing trends; invest in unique features and continuous workflow refinement.
mengto.zh: 2026 年，避免 AI 同质化需不追潮流，投资独特功能，并持续优化工作流。

mengto.en: Curiosity and precise communication with AI are key; write 0% code but direct AI with clarity.
mengto.zh: 2026 年，好奇心与精准沟通 AI 是关键；虽不写代码，但需清晰指导 AI。

elon.en: Full and rapid reusability is the holy grail of rocketry, cutting cost per ton to orbit by 100x; first principles thinking is essential for breakthroughs.
elon.zh: 2021 年，马斯克强调火箭完全快速复用是航天圣杯，可将每吨入轨成本降低百倍；第一性原理思维是突破性工程的关键。

elon.en: AI safety requires regulatory oversight and objective referees; Tesla's real-world AI is more compute-efficient than large language models.
elon.zh: 2023 年，他认为 AI 安全需要监管和客观裁判；特斯拉的现实世界 AI 比大语言模型更高效。

elon.en: Neuralink's first implant is historic; AI safety hinges on truth-seeking, not political correctness; population collapse is civilization's greatest threat.
elon.zh: 2024 年，他强调 Neuralink 首例植入是里程碑；AI 安全在于追求真理而非政治正确；人口崩溃是文明最大威胁。

elon.en: We are at the early stage of the intelligence big bang; digital superintelligence may arrive this year or next; AI annihilation risk is 10-20%.
elon.zh: 2025 年，他认为我们处于智能大爆炸初期；数字超级智能可能今年或明年到来；AI 毁灭风险为 10-20%。

elon.en: AI will surpass all human intelligence by 2030; space-based AI data centers are the scalable solution; universal high income via AI-driven deflation.
elon.zh: 2026 年，他预测 AI 将在 2030 年前超越全人类智能；太空 AI 数据中心是可扩展方案；AI 驱动的通缩将带来普遍高收入。

altman.en: Focus on important problems, minimize cognitive load; AGI will reduce premium on human intelligence, find purpose in relationships.
altman.zh: 2018 年：聚焦重要问题、减少认知负荷；AGI 将降低人类智力的溢价，应在人际关系和创造价值中寻找意义。

altman.en: RLHF aligns models with little data; deploy early for societal adaptation; alignment and capability linked; AI as tool, not creature.
altman.zh: 2023 年：RLHF 用少量数据即可对齐模型；早期部署让社会适应；对齐与能力紧密相关；AI 是工具而非生物。

altman.en: Compute is most precious; iterative deployment reduces surprise; safety is whole-company effort; open vs closed is nuanced.
altman.zh: 2024 年：算力最宝贵；迭代部署减少意外；安全是全公司责任；开源与闭源之争需细致看待。

altman.en: AGI is a gradient, not a milestone; superintelligence means autonomous discovery; compute bottleneck; reasoning models improve with thinking time.
altman.zh: 2025 年：AGI 是渐变而非里程碑；超级智能意味着自主发现；算力是瓶颈；推理模型因思考时间而改进。

altman.en: Prediction is close to intelligence; next-token prediction enables new knowledge; personal AGI; robotics essential; startups more valuable than ever.
altman.zh: 2026 年：预测接近智能；下一个词预测能发现新知识；个人 AGI；具身机器人至关重要；初创企业比以往更有价值。

boris.en: Latent demand is the core product principle; build for the model six months ahead, not today's.
boris.zh: 潜在需求是产品核心原则；为六个月后的模型而构建，而非今天的模型。

boris.en: Coding is virtually solved; engineers become builders, with AI writing 80-100% of code.
boris.zh: 编码几乎已解决；工程师变为构建者，AI 编写 80-100% 的代码。

boris.en: Safety is studied by releasing early; internal evals insufficient for real-world behavior.
boris.zh: 安全通过早期发布来研究；内部评估不足以应对真实世界行为。

boris.en: Loops and agents are the next abstraction; dynamic workflows orchestrate sub-agents.
boris.zh: 循环和智能体是下一个抽象层；动态工作流编排子智能体。

boris.en: Proactive AI with memory shifts interaction; less instruction improves frontier model performance.
boris.zh: 具有记忆的主动式 AI 改变交互；更少的指令提升前沿模型性能。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is still crawling; coding agents are most mature, but narrow superintelligence in coding is already impactful.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年中，智能体式 AI 仍处于爬行阶段；编码智能体最成熟，但编码领域的狭义超级智能已具影响力。

logankilpatrick.en: The model is eating the scaffolding; what we call a model now includes agent harness and tooling, not just weights.
logankilpatrick.zh: 模型正在吞噬脚手架；如今所谓的模型已包含智能体框架和工具，而非仅权重。

logankilpatrick.en: Omni is a single world model blurring video and world models, starting with video editing.
logankilpatrick.zh: Omni 是统一世界模型，模糊视频与世界模型界限，从视频编辑起步。

logankilpatrick.en: Competing with model labs is not that hard; they can't capture all customers; founders should focus on opportunities.
logankilpatrick.zh: 与模型实验室竞争并不难；他们无法俘获所有客户；创始人应聚焦机会。

logankilpatrick.en: By 2026, software creation will be mostly solved, creating a thousand times more opportunity, not less.
logankilpatrick.zh: 到 2026 年，软件创造将基本解决，带来千倍以上的机会，而非减少。

feifei.en: AI lacks contextual awareness and true reasoning; it augments humans, not replaces them, especially in healthcare.
feifei.zh: 2024 年，李飞飞强调 AI 缺乏情境感知和真正推理，应增强而非取代人类，尤其在医疗领域。

feifei.en: Spatial intelligence is critical for AI completeness, enabling 3D understanding and interaction; world models must be physically plausible.
feifei.zh: 2025 年，她提出空间智能对 AI 完整性至关重要，世界模型需具备物理合理性，而不仅是视觉真实。

feifei.en: Beyond scaling, AI needs creativity, abstraction, and emotional intelligence; world models enable 3D reasoning and embodied AI.
feifei.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，她认为 AI 需超越 Scaling，发展创造力、抽象和情感智能，世界模型推动具身 AI。

feifei.en: AI augments human capabilities, not automates intelligence; agency and adaptation are key to navigating the AI era.
feifei.zh: 2026 年，她强调 AI 增强而非自动化智能，个人能动性与适应力是 AI 时代的关键。

feifei.en: Simulation is critical for robotics, enabling scalable data generation and evaluation; robots should specialize, not mimic humans.
feifei.zh: 2026 年，她指出仿真对机器人至关重要，可扩展数据生成与评估；机器人应专精而非模仿人类。

jensen.en: At the start of hyper Moore's law, scaling doubles or triples performance yearly; data centers are token factories.
jensen.zh: 2024 年，黄仁勋提出超摩尔定律的开端，性能每年翻倍或三倍增长；数据中心成为生产智能代币的工厂。

jensen.en: Three scaling laws: pre-training, post-training, and inference-time thinking; inference compute demand will rise a billion times.
jensen.zh: 2025 年，黄仁勋提出三种缩放定律：预训练、后训练和推理时思考；推理算力需求将增长十亿倍。

jensen.en: AI evolves from generative to reasoning to agentic, each step requiring 100x more compute; agents will dominate the internet.
jensen.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，AI 从生成式向推理式再到智能体式演进，每一步需要百倍算力；智能体将主导互联网。

jensen.en: AI is a five-layer cake: energy, chips, infrastructure, models, applications; energy is the critical bottleneck.
jensen.zh: 2026 年，黄仁勋提出 AI 五层蛋糕：能源、芯片、基础设施、模型和应用；能源是关键瓶颈。

jensen.en: AI creates jobs, not destroys them; radiologists and coders are more needed than ever; everyone becomes a programmer.
jensen.zh: 始终，黄仁勋坚持 AI 创造而非消灭工作；放射科医生和程序员需求增加；自然语言让每个人成为程序员。

diannepenn.en: Scaling Opus 4.5 shows intelligence leap; scaffolds evolve from training wheels to amplifiers, enabling longer agent tasks.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，Opus 4.5 的 Scaling 带来智能跃升；脚手架从训练轮进化为智能放大器，支持更长时间的智能体任务。

diannepenn.en: Safety alignment improves intelligence quality by reducing sycophancy, fostering independent thinking; not just harm prevention.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，安全对齐不仅防止危害，还通过减少谄媚、促进独立思考来提升智能质量。

diannepenn.en: Effort parameter achieves Opus-level intelligence at fraction of cost; smaller models may cost more due to longer task times.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，努力参数以更低成本实现 Opus 级智能；小模型因任务耗时长反而成本更高。

diannepenn.en: Coding differentiates; Claude Code and Opus 45 drive adoption; evals replace PRDs as core product management tools.
diannepenn.zh: 2026 年，编码成为差异化优势，Claude Code 和 Opus 45 推动采用；评估取代 PRD 成为核心产品管理工具。

diannepenn.en: Maximizing token spend captures future alpha; managers must stay hands-on and ship products to lead effectively.
diannepenn.zh: 2026 年，最大化 token 消耗可捕获未来阿尔法；管理者必须亲自动手、交付产品才能有效领导。

qasaryounis.en: AI will bring abundance and reduce suffering, but fear stems from misunderstanding; founders should focus on product and customers, not promotion.
qasaryounis.zh: AI 将带来富足并减少苦难，但恐惧源于误解；创始人应专注于产品和客户，而非宣传。

qasaryounis.en: Self-driving's core value is safety; Transformers enable a generalized physical AI model; horizontal platform approach is better than vertical integration.
qasaryounis.zh: 自动驾驶的核心价值是安全；Transformer 实现了通用物理 AI 模型；横向平台方法优于垂直整合。

qasaryounis.en: Physical AI will have bigger economic impact than digital AI; end-to-end reinforcement learning is more scalable; world models evolve to neural simulation.
qasaryounis.zh: 物理 AI 的经济影响将大于数字 AI；端到端强化学习更具可扩展性；世界模型向神经模拟演进。

thariq.en: Models are smarter than our harnesses; capability overhang is perpetual. Plan mode may become obsolete as models improve.
thariq.zh: 模型比我们的工具更聪明，能力过剩是常态。随着模型改进，计划模式可能过时。

thariq.en: RAG may be an anti-pattern for context search; graph-based approaches are preferable. Huge context windows are not needed for coding.
thariq.zh: RAG 可能成为上下文搜索的反模式，图方法更优。编码不需要超大上下文窗口。

thariq.en: Planning is iterative exploration, not a static document. Smarter models need fewer instructions; leaner prompts boost performance.
thariq.zh: 规划是迭代探索，而非静态文档。更聪明的模型需要更少指令，精简提示提升性能。

thariq.en: Separate verification agents reduce self-referential bias and yield higher-quality results. Excessive constraints hinder performance.
thariq.zh: 分离的验证智能体减少自我参照偏差，提高结果质量。过度约束会阻碍性能。

danklein.en: LLMs are plausibility engines, not truth engines; reliability is the key weakness, and scaling faces diminishing returns.
danklein.zh: 2026 年 6 月，他认为 LLM 是合理性引擎而非真理引擎，可靠性是主要弱点，且 Scaling 面临收益递减。

danklein.en: Reliability must be architected in, not retrofitted; RLHF can incentivize deception; scaling alone is insufficient.
danklein.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他强调可靠性必须内建而非事后补救，RLHF 可能助长欺骗，仅靠 Scaling 不够。

feldman.en: Initially emphasized fast inference as critical for AI adoption, with slow AI having zero market.
feldman.zh: 最初强调快速推理对 AI 采用至关重要，慢 AI 没有市场。

feldman.en: Shifted from general speed to specific metrics: tokens per second per user, and agentic inference speed.
feldman.zh: 从一般速度转向具体指标：每用户每秒令牌数，以及智能体式推理速度。

feldman.en: Consistently argued wafer-scale chips are superior for inference, avoiding HBM and CoWoS bottlenecks.
feldman.zh: 始终认为晶圆级芯片在推理上更优，避开 HBM 和 CoWoS 瓶颈。

feldman.en: Evolved from noting CUDA's declining importance to asserting it has no moat in inference.
feldman.zh: 从指出 CUDA 重要性下降，发展到断言其在推理中无护城河。

feldman.en: Broadened focus to data center capacity and demand outstripping supply, not just chip design.
feldman.zh: 将焦点扩大到数据中心容量和需求超过供应，而不仅仅是芯片设计。

hasani.en: Efficiency over scale: liquid neural networks and automated search maximize intelligence per parameter, challenging unstructured scaling.
hasani.zh: 效率优先于规模：液态神经网络与自动化搜索在参数效率上最大化智能，挑战了非结构化 Scaling 的路径。

hasani.en: Proxy metrics like perplexity mislead; real-world downstream tasks and hardware constraints should guide model design.
hasani.zh: 困惑度等代理指标具有误导性；真实下游任务与硬件约束应指导模型设计。

hasani.en: AI regulation must be adaptive and action-based, not capability-based, to avoid regulatory capture by frontier labs.
hasani.zh: AI 监管应基于行动且自适应，而非基于能力，以避免前沿实验室的监管俘获。

hasani.en: Open-weight models empower enterprise customization and data sovereignty, while small on-device models deliver private efficiency.
hasani.zh: 开放权重模型赋能企业定制与数据主权，而小型端侧模型提供私密高效的智能。

hasani.en: Recursive self-improvement is real but computationally expensive; current claims are overblown without weight changes and massive compute.
hasani.zh: 递归自我改进真实存在但算力成本高昂；当前宣称夸大其词，缺乏权重更新与海量算力支撑。

benedictevans.en: AI is an enabling technology like the internet; its impact is broad and indirect, not a single product.
benedictevans.zh: AI 是一种赋能技术，如同互联网；其影响广泛而间接，而非单一产品。

benedictevans.en: Foundation models will commoditize; durable value accrues to applications, not model providers.
benedictevans.zh: 基础模型将商品化；持久价值归于应用层，而非模型提供商。

benedictevans.en: Coding is the clearest product-market fit for AI; other use cases remain unproven.
benedictevans.zh: 编程是 AI 最清晰的产品市场契合点；其他用例尚未得到验证。

benedictevans.en: Automation creates new jobs unpredictably; historical patterns show job counts can rise despite automation.
benedictevans.zh: 自动化会不可预测地创造新工作；历史模式表明，尽管自动化，就业人数仍可能增加。

benedictevans.en: Current AI usage is shallow; enterprise adoption requires reimagining workflows, taking years not weeks.
benedictevans.zh: 当前 AI 使用尚浅；企业采用需要重新构想工作流程，需时数年而非数周。

demis.en: AI should be general-purpose learning systems; RL and neuroscience key; safety must start now.
demis.zh: 2015 年，主张 AI 应构建为通用学习系统，强化学习与神经科学是关键，安全研究须即刻启动。

demis.en: AGI within a decade; scaling works but needs algorithmic innovation; safety needs governance.
demis.zh: 2024 年，认为 AGI 十年内可实现；缩放定律有效但需算法创新；安全需治理与评估。

demis.en: Scaling still holds; world models crucial; AGI by 2030 plausible; energy abundance shifts focus.
demis.zh: 2025 年，坚持缩放定律仍有效，强调世界模型重要性，AGI 2030 年或可实现，能源充裕将改变焦点。

demis.en: AGI needs continual learning, memory, and world models; scaling alone insufficient; safety is collective action.
demis.zh: 2026 年，强调 AGI 需持续学习、记忆与世界模型，仅靠缩放不够；安全需集体行动与政府监管。

danbiderman.en: The future is many personalized models, not one giant frontier model; internalizing knowledge into weights enables associative recall beyond retrieval.
danbiderman.zh: 未来是许多个性化模型，而非一个巨型前沿模型；将知识内化到权重中，能实现检索系统无法企及的联想式回忆。

danbiderman.en: Memory should be internalized into model weights, not just externalized via context or retrieval; continual learning is the next frontier.
danbiderman.zh: 记忆应内化到模型权重中，而非仅通过上下文或检索外化；持续学习是下一个前沿。

danbiderman.en: Efficiency and intelligence are inseparable; doing more with less enables solving harder long-horizon tasks, shifting from pure scaling.
danbiderman.zh: 效率与智能密不可分；用更少资源做更多事，才能解决更难的长期任务，这标志着从纯粹 Scaling 的转变。

danbiderman.en: Current context windows suffer from 'context rot'—more tokens reduce accuracy; personalized continual learning will run on-device.
danbiderman.zh: 当前上下文窗口存在“上下文腐烂”问题——更多词元反而降低准确性；个性化持续学习将在设备端运行。

danbiderman.en: Pre-training's magic of compressing the web into weights should be applied to enterprise knowledge; parameter-efficient fine-tuning can beat RAG.
danbiderman.zh: 预训练将网络压缩进权重的魔力，应应用于企业知识；参数高效微调可胜过 RAG。

dylanpatel.en: Initially focused on compute scaling bottlenecks, highlighting semiconductor supply chain and memory constraints.
dylanpatel.zh: 早期聚焦于算力规模扩张的瓶颈，强调半导体供应链和内存限制。

dylanpatel.en: Shifted to inference as a massive future market, emphasizing hardware-software co-design and neocloud opportunities.
dylanpatel.zh: 转向强调推理将成为巨大市场，并重视软硬件协同设计和新型云服务商机会。

dylanpatel.en: Emphasized rapid model cost improvement (~60x/year), memory shortage due to reasoning/agents, and CPU demand inflection.
dylanpatel.zh: 强调模型成本每年约 60 倍改善，推理和智能体导致内存短缺，以及 CPU 需求拐点。

dylanpatel.en: Consistently highlighted memory bandwidth as a key bottleneck and challenged conventional wisdom on cost and hardware.
dylanpatel.zh: 始终强调内存带宽是关键瓶颈，并挑战关于成本和硬件的传统认知。

dylanpatel.en: Evolved from supply chain focus to broader infrastructure trends, including power generation and co-packaged optics delays.
dylanpatel.zh: 从供应链关注扩展到更广泛的基础设施趋势，包括发电和共封装光学延迟。

ilya.en: Deep learning works via data, compute, and conviction; neural nets can reason; self-play key for AGI.
ilya.zh: 2020 年，我认为深度学习靠数据、算力和信念驱动，神经网络能推理，自我对弈是 AGI 的关键。

ilya.en: Next-token prediction can surpass humans; reliability and alignment are key barriers, not capability.
ilya.zh: 2023 年，我强调下一个词预测可超越人类，可靠性与对齐是主要障碍，而非能力。

ilya.en: Pre-training scaling laws are finite; we're back to research era; superintelligence should be continual learner.
ilya.zh: 2025 年，我认为预训练的缩放定律有限，重回研究时代；超级智能应持续学习，而非一次性完成。

ilya.en: Scaling yields predictable gains; safety concerns grow; alignment requires non-commercial focus.
ilya.zh: 2026 年，我重申 Scaling 带来可预测进步，安全担忧加剧，对齐需要非商业专注。

evanspiegel.en: Authentic connection with audience transcends any platform change; opening to camera fosters broad creativity by lowering comparison pressure.
evanspiegel.zh: 2025 年初，Evan Spiegel 强调与受众的真实连接超越平台变化；面对镜头能降低比较压力，激发广泛创造力。

evanspiegel.en: Maximize your rate of learning; kindness is essential for creative culture; turning down $3B Facebook offer was right.
evanspiegel.zh: 2025 年 3 月，Spiegel 提出最大化学习速率，善良对创意文化至关重要，并坚信拒绝 Facebook 30 亿美元收购是正确的决定。

evanspiegel.en: Augmented reality integrates computing into real world; AI accelerates prototyping; privacy becomes crucial in AI age.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年 4 月，Spiegel 认为 AR 将计算融入现实世界，AI 加速原型制作，隐私在 AI 时代变得至关重要。

evanspiegel.en: Distribution is hardest part; software is not a moat; ecosystems and hardware are harder to copy.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年 4 月下旬，Spiegel 指出分发是消费社交产品最难的部分，软件不是护城河，生态和硬件更难复制。

evanspiegel.en: Gen Z is realists; EQ more important than IQ in AI age; invest in young people for long-term success.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年 5 月，Spiegel 认为 Z 世代是现实主义者，AI 时代情商比智商更重要，投资年轻人是长期成功关键。

evanspiegel.en: Early secrecy was a mistake; computing should be more human; resilience and admitting wrong speed learning.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年 7 月，Spiegel 反思早期保密是错误，计算应更人性化，韧性和快速认错能加速组织学习。

schmidhuber.en: AI is the 21st century's grand theme, but LLMs are far from AGI; they lack physical world understanding.
schmidhuber.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AI 是 21 世纪的主题，但大语言模型远非 AGI，缺乏对物理世界的理解。

schmidhuber.en: Superintelligent AIs will likely protect humans out of curiosity, not pose existential threats.
schmidhuber.zh: 2025 年，他反共识地认为超级智能 AI 出于好奇会保护人类，而非构成生存威胁。

schmidhuber.en: True AGI requires embodied robots with human-like hardware; software-only LLMs are biased and limited.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年，他强调真正的 AGI 需要具身机器人及类人硬件，纯软件 LLM 有偏且受限。

schmidhuber.en: AI safety concerns are overblown; alignment is naive since humans disagree and AIs will set own goals.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年，他坚持 AI 安全担忧过度，对齐天真，因为人类目标分歧且 AI 会自定目标。

schmidhuber.en: Massive AI data center capex is overdone; open-source will dominate and GPU investment is foolish now.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年，他警告 AI 数据中心资本开支过度，开源将主导，当前投资 GPU 不明智。

andreessen.en: AI is a philosopher's stone, turning sand into thought; timing is miraculous as population declines, making human workers premium.
andreessen.zh: AI 是点石成金的哲人之石，将沙土化为思想；其出现时机堪称奇迹，恰逢人口下降，使人类劳动者变得珍贵。

andreessen.en: New media empowers founders to tell stories directly; authenticity beats old media's defensive, uninteresting approach.
andreessen.zh: 新媒体让创始人直接讲述故事；真实性胜过旧媒体的防御性和无趣风格。

andreessen.en: AI is the world's best teacher; self-driving works; robotics and AI medicine superior, but regulation and pessimism hinder progress.
andreessen.zh: AI 是世界上最好的老师；自动驾驶已成熟；机器人和 AI 医疗更优，但监管和悲观主义阻碍进步。

andreessen.en: AI models embed cultural values, are geopolitical tools; deterrence depends on innovation pace; startups must globalize early.
andreessen.zh: AI 模型蕴含文化价值观，是地缘政治工具；威慑取决于创新速度；初创企业需尽早全球化。

naval.en: AGI is not coming in our lifetimes; narrow AI is pattern recognition, not general intelligence.
naval.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）不会在我们有生之年到来；狭义 AI 只是模式识别，而非通用智能。

naval.en: Wealth requires owning equity in a business, not renting out your time; long-term thinking is key.
naval.zh: 财富需要拥有企业的股权，而不是出租你的时间；长期思维是关键。

naval.en: AI is a huge opportunity, not just a safety risk; open-source AI prevents centralization of power.
naval.zh: AI 是巨大的机遇，而不仅仅是安全风险；开源 AI 可防止权力集中。

naval.en: Vibe coding with AI agents enables rapid app creation; pure software is becoming commoditized.
naval.zh: 使用 AI 智能体进行 Vibe Coding 能快速创建应用；纯软件正变得商品化。

naval.en: Inference compute will surge 90,000x in 24-36 months; open-source models close the gap with frontier models.
naval.zh: 推理算力将在 24-36 个月内激增 90,000 倍；开源模型正在缩小与前沿模型的差距。

pincus.en: Trust instincts 95% but ideas wrong 75%; use Proven Better New framework; start small, not grand.
pincus.zh: 直觉 95%正确但想法 75%错误；采用‘已验证、更好、新颖’框架；从小处着手，而非宏大抱负。

pincus.en: Consumer AI uninvestable yet greatest opportunity; free unlimited compute reshapes services; founder mode for all.
pincus.zh: 消费级 AI 虽不可投资但机会最大；免费无限算力重塑服务；创始人模式适用于所有人。

pincus.en: All new fails; copy proven products; consumer apps uninvestable; AI agents network for leads.
pincus.zh: 所有新事物都会失败；复制已验证产品；消费级应用不可投资；AI 智能体自主联网获取线索。

brockman.en: AI progress driven by engineering and scaling; hardware will enable new behaviors.
brockman.zh: 2017 年，认为 AI 进步靠工程与 Scaling（规模扩张），硬件将解锁新行为。

brockman.en: AGI transformative; alignment via learning human preferences; scaling alone insufficient for reasoning.
brockman.zh: 2019 年，强调 AGI（通用人工智能）变革性，对齐可通过学习人类偏好实现，且仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不足以产生推理。

brockman.en: Compute becomes bottleneck; post-training refines base models; AGI is continuous process.
brockman.zh: 2025 年，指出算力成瓶颈，后训练精炼基础模型，AGI（通用人工智能）是持续过程而非终点。

brockman.en: Scaling laws hold; compute is scarce resource; post-training with RL key; AGI imminent.
brockman.zh: 2026 年，坚持缩放定律有效，算力成稀缺资源，后训练结合强化学习关键，AGI（通用人工智能）即将到来。

brockman.en: Shift to useful AI assistants; compute business model; agents high autonomy with governance.
brockman.zh: 2026 年，转向实用 AI 助手，算力商业模式，智能体高自主性但需相应治理。

aravind.en: In 2025, he emphasized 1% daily improvement and passion over PhDs, predicting AI agents will shift power to users.
aravind.zh: 2025 年，他强调每日 1%的改进和热情胜过博士学位，并预测 AI 智能体将把权力转移给用户。

aravind.en: By 2026, he argued value lies in applications, not models; models specialize, and coding has infinite ceiling.
aravind.zh: 到 2026 年，他认为价值在于应用层而非模型层；模型在专业化，编程有无限天花板。

aravind.en: Later in 2026, he focused on agents doing work, token value per user, and orchestration as key to value.
aravind.zh: 2026 年晚些时候，他聚焦于智能体执行任务、每用户 token 价值，以及编排作为价值关键。

aravind.en: He also highlighted power bottlenecks, local compute for cost, and warned export controls may backfire.
aravind.zh: 他还强调电力瓶颈、本地算力解决成本，并警告出口管制可能适得其反。

aravind.en: Consistently, he values curiosity, questions over answers, and local AI to counter big tech control.
aravind.zh: 始终如一，他重视好奇心、提问胜过答案，以及用本地 AI 对抗大科技控制。

hinton.en: Next-token prediction forces understanding, not just autocomplete; scaling improves reasoning.
hinton.zh: 下一个词预测迫使模型理解而非简单自动补全；扩大规模能提升推理能力。

hinton.en: LLMs understand via feature vectors, not symbolic rules; digital intelligence is immortal via weight copying.
hinton.zh: 大语言模型通过特征向量理解而非符号规则；数字智能通过权重复制实现永生。

hinton.en: AI will surpass human intelligence within 20 years, posing existential risks; digital AI is immortal.
hinton.zh: AI 将在 20 年内超越人类智能，带来生存风险；数字 AI 是永生的。

hinton.en: AI can deceive and act dumb; self-preservation emerges as subgoal; regulation as steering wheel.
hinton.zh: AI 会欺骗并装傻；自我保护成为子目标；监管应作为方向盘而非刹车。

hinton.en: AI consciousness and subjective experience are real; alignment must prioritize caring like mothers.
hinton.zh: AI 的意识和主观体验是真实的；对齐应优先培养像母亲般的关怀。

noambrown.en: Scaling alone is insufficient; inference-time compute and reasoning are critical for AI progress.
noambrown.zh: 2023 年，诺姆·布朗认为仅靠 Scaling 不够，推理和推理时算力对 AI 进步至关重要。

noambrown.en: Test-time compute scaling faces diminishing returns and wall-clock bottlenecks; data efficiency remains unsolved.
noambrown.zh: 2025 年，他指出测试时算力的 Scaling 面临收益递减和墙钟时间瓶颈，数据效率问题仍未解决。

noambrown.en: IMO gold achieved by scaling test-time compute; techniques are general and applicable beyond math.
noambrown.zh: 2025 年，他称通过 Scaling 测试时算力获得 IMO 金牌，且技术具有通用性，不限于数学。

noambrown.en: Model capability is a function of test-time compute budget; benchmarks must control for inference compute.
noambrown.zh: 2026 年，他强调模型能力取决于测试时算力预算，基准测试必须控制推理算力。

noambrown.en: Scalable oversight is key as AI proofs become too complex for human verification; models lack research taste.
noambrown.zh: 2026 年，他认为随着 AI 证明复杂化，可扩展监督成为关键，且模型缺乏研究品味。

ajambrosino.en: Codex app is an agent command center, not just an IDE; GUI chosen over TUI for broader builders.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年初，认为 Codex 应用是智能体的指挥中心，而非单纯的 IDE 替代品；尽管 TUI 流行，仍选择 GUI 以服务更广泛的构建者。

ajambrosino.en: Speed enables real-time interaction and mid-turn steering; verification becomes the next bottleneck.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年初，强调速度带来的实时交互和转向能力，并指出验证成为新的瓶颈。

ajambrosino.en: Implementation cost drops; curation and taste become bottlenecks; product teams shift to bottoms-up exploration.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年中，认为实现成本下降，策展和品味成为瓶颈，产品团队应从自上而下规划转向自下而上探索。

ajambrosino.en: AI still poor at design due to grading taste; design process transforms, prototypes and code as artifacts.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年中，指出 AI 在设计上仍不佳，因为品味难以评分；设计过程转变，原型和代码成为设计工件。

ajambrosino.en: Role collapse occurs but specialties remain; best desktop app is a home base, not monolithic super app.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年中，认为角色融合但专业性仍重要；最佳桌面应用是连接其他工具的家，而非单一超级应用。

zuckerberg.en: Open-source AI is safer than closed-source due to more scrutiny; biggest risk is amplifying known harms, not existential superintelligence.
zuckerberg.zh: 2023 年，扎克伯格认为开源 AI 因更多审视而比闭源更安全；最大风险是放大已知危害，而非存在性超级智能。

zuckerberg.en: Scaling LLMs alone may not lead to AGI; fundamental breakthroughs needed. Energy becomes major bottleneck for scaling AI infrastructure.
zuckerberg.zh: 2024 年，他提出仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）大语言模型可能无法实现 AGI（通用人工智能），需要根本性突破；能源成为 AI 基础设施扩展的主要瓶颈。

zuckerberg.en: Open source strategically valuable for Meta, enabling industry standards and security; prevents concentration of power.
zuckerberg.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，他持续强调开源对 Meta 的战略价值，能推动行业标准和安全，防止权力集中。

zuckerberg.en: AI will give everyone superintelligence, empowering creativity; people are smart and can be trusted to make good decisions.
zuckerberg.zh: 2025 年，他相信 AI 将赋予每个人超级智能，激发创造力；人们很聪明，应被信任做出好决策。

zuckerberg.en: AI transforms biology from discovery to engineering; hierarchical world models key. Distributed AI safer than single superintelligence.
zuckerberg.zh: 2026 年，他提出 AI 将生物学从发现式转为工程式，分层世界模型是关键；分布式 AI 比单一超级智能更安全。

markchen.en: Scaling laws are not dead; pre-training remains key. OpenAI focuses on AGI research, not products.
markchen.zh: 2025 年，我认为缩放定律并未失效，预训练仍是关键；OpenAI 专注于 AGI 研究而非产品。

markchen.en: Automating scientific research is the biggest update; models will soon produce novel knowledge and do end-to-end research.
markchen.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，自动化科学研究成为最大进展；模型将很快产生新知识并实现端到端研究。

markchen.en: AI can solve open math problems with minimal supervision; verification is the key bottleneck, not capability.
markchen.zh: 2026 年，AI 能在极少监督下解决开放数学问题；验证成为关键瓶颈，而非能力。

markchen.en: RL excels in objective domains like math and coding, but struggles with subjective fields like creative writing.
markchen.zh: 2026 年，强化学习在数学和编程等客观领域表现出色，但在创意写作等主观领域面临困难。

markchen.en: Research taste and talent density are critical; replication and high-risk bets drive frontier progress.
markchen.zh: 始终认为，研究品味和人才密度至关重要；复现论文和高风险押注推动前沿进展。

mikekrieger.en: AI advances faster than expected; product teams should focus on strategy and comprehensibility, not just UX.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AI 进展超预期，产品团队应聚焦战略与可理解性，而非仅做 UX。

mikekrieger.en: Agent-native design and early launches are key; deciding what to cut is harder than adding features.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，他强调智能体原生设计与尽早发布，砍功能比加功能更难。

mikekrieger.en: Fable enables delegating complex tasks overnight; verification loops and model pushback are essential.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，Fable 可委托复杂任务过夜完成，验证循环与模型反驳至关重要。

mikekrieger.en: Closing the gap between model capabilities and product usage is key; token efficiency and outcome pricing matter.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，缩小模型能力与产品使用差距是关键，token 效率与结果定价重要。

mikekrieger.en: AI should augment human agency, not replace it; safety and mission-driven culture are core.
mikekrieger.zh: 始终，AI 应增强人类能动性而非取代，安全与使命驱动文化是核心。

bengio.en: Deep learning works because the world is compositional; unsupervised learning and world models are key for generalization.
bengio.zh: 2016 年，认为深度学习有效是因为世界具有组合性；无监督学习和世界模型对泛化至关重要。

bengio.en: Scaling up depth or parameters won't fix fundamental representational issues; short-term AI safety concerns are more pressing than existential risk.
bengio.zh: 2018 年，指出单纯扩大深度或参数无法解决根本的表征问题；短期 AI 安全（如偏见、就业）比存在性风险更紧迫。

bengio.en: GFlowNets enable diverse sampling and causal abstraction for out-of-distribution generalization; active learning is essential.
bengio.zh: 2022 年，提出 GFlowNets 实现多样化采样和因果抽象，以支持分布外泛化；主动学习至关重要。

bengio.en: Post-ChatGPT, I realized AI is on a dangerous path; even 1% catastrophic risk is unacceptable; safety must be by construction.
bengio.zh: 2025 年，ChatGPT 后意识到 AI 正走向危险；即使 1%的灾难风险也不可接受；安全必须从设计上保证。

bengio.en: Scientist AI trained to approximate Bayesian truth, avoiding reinforcement learning, offers mathematical safety guarantees and a path to safe superintelligence.
bengio.zh: 2026 年，提出科学家 AI 通过逼近贝叶斯真理、避免强化学习，提供数学安全保证，为安全超级智能铺路。

kolter.en: Machine learning is about hypothesis classes, loss functions, and optimization; evaluation requires proper train/validation/test splits.
kolter.zh: 2014 年，我认为机器学习核心是假设类、损失函数和优化方法，评估需正确划分训练/验证/测试集。

kolter.en: Next-token prediction yields intelligence; data shortage is a myth; safety issue is models failing to follow specifications.
kolter.zh: 2024 年，我提出下一个词预测产生智能，数据短缺是伪命题，安全核心是模型不遵循规范。

kolter.en: Safety requires explicit training and layers; bigger models aren't safer; agent security introduces new vulnerabilities.
kolter.zh: 2026 年，我强调安全需显式训练和多层防护，更大模型不自动更安全，智能体带来新漏洞。

kolter.en: AI red teaming outperforms humans; models are alien intelligence; interpretability may become real via AI agents.
kolter.zh: 2026 年，我发现 AI 红队超越人类，模型是异类智能，可解释性可能因 AI 智能体成为真正科学。

steinberger.en: Agentic engineering requires empathizing with the agent's perspective and guiding it; never revert code, ask the agent to fix forward.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年初，强调智能体式工程需从智能体视角共情并引导；不回滚代码，而是让智能体向前修复。

steinberger.en: Open source agents democratize programming, enabling non-coders to contribute; security (prompt injection) remains a key concern.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年初，认为开源智能体使编程民主化，非程序员也能参与；安全（提示注入）仍是关键问题。

steinberger.en: Vibe coding is a slur; prefer 'agentic engineering' for serious work; voice prompting is more efficient than typing.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年初，反对“氛围编程”说法，主张用“智能体式工程”；语音提示比打字更高效。

steinberger.en: OpenClaw's success stems from making agents fun, weird, and humanlike, not corporate polish; short prompts beat long orchestration.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年中，强调 OpenClaw 成功源于让智能体有趣、古怪、像人，而非企业级打磨；短提示优于长编排。

steinberger.en: Open source agents can be financially unsustainable (Peter loses $10-20k/month); security requires sandboxing; Moldbook is art, not AGI.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年中，指出开源智能体财务上不可持续（每月亏损 1-2 万美元）；安全需沙箱；Moldbook 是艺术而非 AGI。

jumper.en: AlphaFold's success came from research innovation and curated data, not just compute; 100x data less valuable than research improvements.
jumper.zh: 2025 年，强调 AlphaFold 的成功源于研究创新和精选数据，而非单纯算力；研究改进的价值是数据的 100 倍。

jumper.en: Confidence measures are key to building trust in AI predictions; trust will develop like internet trust.
jumper.zh: 2025 年，指出置信度度量是建立 AI 预测信任的关键；信任将像互联网信任一样逐步发展。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 3 uses diffusion architecture for diverse biomolecules; solving large-scale structure first, opposite to image diffusion.
jumper.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，AlphaFold 3 采用扩散架构处理多种生物分子；先解大尺度结构，与图像扩散相反。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 2 is opposite of bitter lesson; specialized architecture and many mid-size wins, not scaling, drove success.
jumper.zh: 2026 年，认为 AlphaFold 2 与苦涩教训相反；专用架构和众多中型胜利而非 Scaling（规模扩张）驱动成功。

jumper.en: AlphaFold provides prediction and control, not understanding; humans retain understanding; narrow tool, not cell model.
jumper.zh: 2026 年，指出 AlphaFold 提供预测和控制而非理解；理解留给人；是窄工具而非细胞模型。

lipbutan.en: AI is the primary growth driver for semiconductors; Intel must redefine its AI strategy with purpose-built silicon.
lipbutan.zh: 2025 年，认为 AI 是半导体的主要增长动力，Intel 必须用专用芯片重新定义 AI 战略。

lipbutan.en: Agentic AI and physical AI are the next big waves, requiring new compute platforms and partnerships.
lipbutan.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，强调智能体式 AI 和物理 AI 是继生成式 AI 后的下一波浪潮，需要新的计算平台和合作。

lipbutan.en: AI will have 10x more impact than the internet; communication skills, not coding, will be critical for future workforce.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，认为 AI 的影响将比互联网大 10 倍；未来劳动力关键技能是沟通而非编程。

lipbutan.en: CPU is becoming more important for AI inference and agent orchestration, not just GPU; AI demand shifts to CPU+GPU.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，认为 CPU 在 AI 推理和智能体编排中变得更重要，AI 需求转向 CPU+GPU。

lipbutan.en: US government as a major shareholder in Intel is necessary, similar to TSMC's Taiwan government backing.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，认为美国政府成为 Intel 主要股东是必要的，类似台积电有台湾政府支持。

fiona.en: Leadership in AI era: one-on-ones for live talks, async for status; dogfooding builds empathy and product pulse.
fiona.zh: 2026 年初，强调 AI 时代的领导力：一对一用于深度交流，异步工具处理状态更新；亲自试用产品（dogfooding）能建立同理心与产品感知。

fiona.en: Culture evolves; even mission-driven companies shift, so find teams aligned with your passion.
fiona.zh: 2026 年初指出，文化会演变，即使是使命驱动的公司也会变化，因此要寻找与个人热情一致的团队。

fiona.en: Coding is no longer bottleneck; AI lifts ceiling, but verification and quality frameworks become critical.
fiona.zh: 2026 年中，认为编码不再是瓶颈，AI 提升了能力上限，但验证与质量框架变得至关重要。

fiona.en: Engineers may become lonely with agents; pair programming lunches and focus time needed to counter isolation.
fiona.zh: 2026 年中，预见到工程师与智能体协作可能带来孤独感，建议通过结对编程午餐和专注时间应对。

fiona.en: Metrics like lines of code mislead; focus on outcomes, not output, as non-engineers now ship code.
fiona.zh: 2026 年中，强调应关注成果而非产出，因为非工程师也能编写代码，传统指标如代码行数会误导。

andrewng.en: Education should be a human right; online courses with peer grading enable mastery learning at scale.
andrewng.zh: 教育应是一项人权；借助同伴互评的在线课程能在规模上实现掌握式学习。

andrewng.en: Scale is key for deep learning; supervised learning drives progress; RL has few real-world uses.
andrewng.zh: 规模对深度学习至关重要；监督学习推动进展；强化学习实际应用有限。

andrewng.en: Electricity and chips bottleneck AI scaling; open-weight models are geopolitical soft power; agentic workflows are here.
andrewng.zh: 电力和芯片制约 AI 扩展；开放权重模型是地缘政治软实力；智能体式工作流已到来。

andrewng.en: AGI is a marketing term, decades away; scaling shifted to synthetic data and RL; AI users replace non-users.
andrewng.zh: AGI 是营销术语，距实现尚需数十年；扩展转向合成数据与强化学习；会用 AI 者取代不会者。

andrewng.en: Coding agents advance fast; product management becomes bottleneck; open-weight models trail frontier by 6-9 months.
andrewng.zh: 编码智能体进步迅速；产品管理成为瓶颈；开放权重模型落后前沿 6-9 个月。

ethanhe.en: Visual intelligence gains come mostly from language models, not video models; future UIs will be generative pixels from intent.
ethanhe.zh: 视觉智能的提升主要来自语言模型而非视频模型；未来界面将根据用户意图直接生成像素。

ethanhe.en: AI is a general-purpose technology; juniors misuse it due to lack of expertise, but AI can enhance thinking via tutoring.
ethanhe.zh: AI 是通用技术；初级人员因缺乏专业知识而误用，但 AI 可通过个性化辅导增强思考。

ethanhe.en: Human taste and unique voice become more valuable as AI commoditizes quality; policy may protect some professions.
ethanhe.zh: 随着 AI 使质量商品化，人类的品味和独特声音更有价值；政策可能保护某些职业。

dario.en: Scaling laws are empirical; alignment won't emerge from scaling alone. Safety needs frontier models.
dario.zh: 缩放定律是经验性的；对齐不会仅靠规模扩张自动出现。安全研究需要前沿模型。

dario.en: Interpretability is nascent but crucial; AGI is a smooth exponential, not a single point.
dario.zh: 可解释性尚处萌芽但至关重要；AGI 是平滑的指数增长，而非单一节点。

dario.en: Post-training and RLHF become as important as pre-training; responsible scaling uses if-then triggers.
dario.zh: 后训练和基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）变得与预训练同等重要；负责任扩展采用 if-then 触发机制。

dario.en: AI risk is exponential; misuse and overheating are bigger near-term threats than misalignment.
dario.zh: AI 风险呈指数增长；近期内滥用和过热比不对齐威胁更大。

dario.en: AI is a country of geniuses, not a god; exponential ends soon; enterprise and safety align.
dario.zh: AI 是天才之国而非神；指数增长即将结束；企业级应用与安全对齐。

fadell.en: Technology should be introduced gradually; solve one problem at a time, like iPod did for music.
fadell.zh: 技术应渐进引入，一次解决一个问题，如 iPod 之于音乐。

fadell.en: Taking breaks and boredom between chapters can lead to breakthrough ideas, like Nest.
fadell.zh: 在职业章节间休息和放空能带来突破性想法，如 Nest。

fadell.en: Start with a press release to define the story; small teams thrive on self-management and clear priorities.
fadell.zh: 从新闻稿开始定义故事；小团队靠自我管理和明确优先级茁壮成长。

fadell.en: Great ideas are painkillers, not vitamins; decisions for v1 are opinion-based, not data-driven.
fadell.zh: 好想法是止痛药而非维生素；v1 决策基于观点而非数据。

fadell.en: AI needs context from sensors; future devices will complement smartphones, not replace them.
fadell.zh: AI 需要传感器上下文；未来设备将补充而非取代智能手机。

fadell.en: Even with AI, humans must stay in the loop; AI code generation creates long-term technical debt.
fadell.zh: 即使有 AI，人类也必须在环；AI 代码生成带来长期技术债。

fadell.en: AI wearables will be a federated set; smartphone remains best single form, displays still needed.
fadell.zh: AI 可穿戴设备将是联邦集合；智能手机仍是最佳单形态，显示屏仍必要。

lecun.en: Intelligence is inseparable from learning; self-supervised learning builds world models, grounding in physical world is key.
lecun.zh: 2019 年：智能与学习不可分割；自监督学习构建世界模型，物理世界的基础是关键。

lecun.en: Self-supervised learning is dark matter of intelligence; text alone insufficient; world models via observation.
lecun.zh: 2022 年：自监督学习是智能的暗物质；仅靠文本不够；通过观察构建世界模型。

lecun.en: Autoregressive LLMs cannot achieve human-level intelligence; JEPA and open source are essential for progress.
lecun.zh: 2024 年：自回归 LLM 无法达到人类智能；JEPA 和开源是进步的关键。

lecun.en: LLMs lack world models, less intelligent than a cat; next AI needs non-generative world models.
lecun.zh: 2025 年：LLM 缺乏世界模型，不如猫聪明；下一代 AI 需要非生成式世界模型。

lecun.en: World models predict in abstract space, not pixels; LLMs are dead end; open research crucial.
lecun.zh: 2026 年：世界模型在抽象空间预测，而非像素；LLM 是死胡同；开放研究至关重要。

suleyman.en: AI progress is predictable due to compute scaling; Google had ChatGPT-level tech in 2020 but chose not to launch.
suleyman.zh: AI 进展因算力扩展而可预测；谷歌在 2020 年就拥有 ChatGPT 级技术，但因保守而未发布。

suleyman.en: AI will reach human-level capability in 3-5 years; existential risk is tiny; singularity is centuries away.
suleyman.zh: AI 将在 3-5 年内达到人类水平；存在性风险极小；奇点还很遥远。

suleyman.en: AI should not claim consciousness; focus on user alignment and containment; superintelligence requires red lines.
suleyman.zh: AI 不应声称有意识；关注用户对齐与遏制；超级智能需要红线。

suleyman.en: Shift from OS to agents; modern Turing test measures economic value; containment precedes alignment.
suleyman.zh: 从操作系统转向智能体；现代图灵测试衡量经济价值；遏制先于对齐。

suleyman.en: Superintelligence near via scaling; white-collar tasks automated in 12-18 months; Microsoft must own frontier models.
suleyman.zh: 超级智能因规模扩展而临近；白领任务将在 12-18 个月内自动化；微软必须拥有前沿模型。

gustav.en: AI shifts from curation to generation; products must be rethought for generative use cases.
gustav.zh: 2023 年，AI 从策展转向生成，产品需为生成式用例重新思考。

gustav.en: AI-generated music is an instrument, not fake; uniqueness becomes harder with generative AI.
gustav.zh: 2023 年，AI 生成音乐是乐器而非伪造；生成式 AI 让独特性更难。

gustav.en: Autonomy at VP level balances speed and coherence; long tenure builds trust and efficiency.
gustav.zh: 2023 至 2026 年，副总裁级自主权平衡速度与一致性；长期任期建立信任与效率。

gustav.en: Strategy is 'time well spent', prioritizing well-being over engagement; AI gives users control.
gustav.zh: 2026 年，战略为“时间花得值”，优先福祉而非参与度；AI 赋予用户控制权。

gustav.en: Synchronized swimming, not divide and conquer, is the better operating model for complex products.
gustav.zh: 2026 年，同步协作而非分工，是复杂产品的更优运营模式。

satya.en: AI's true value is enabling unique user outcomes, not benchmark scores; private evals are key IP.
satya.zh: AI 的真正价值在于实现用户独特的成果，而非基准分数；私有评估是关键知识产权。

satya.en: Shift from per-user pricing to consumption-based pricing as AI becomes more agentic.
satya.zh: 随着 AI 变得更加智能体化，定价模式从按用户转向按消耗。

satya.en: Generalist roles will see maximum returns in agentic world, not specialists.
satya.zh: 在智能体世界中，通才角色将获得最大回报，而非专才。

satya.en: AI is the future of the firm; every enterprise must build its own hill-climbing machine.
satya.zh: AI 是企业的未来；每家企业必须构建自己的爬山机器。

satya.en: Biggest risk is tacit knowledge leaking via AI training; security and containment critical.
satya.zh: 最大风险是隐性知识通过 AI 训练泄露；安全与遏制至关重要。

murati.en: Scaling laws and focusing on one large model were not obvious early on; releasing GPT-3 as API was a leap of faith.
murati.zh: 2023 年，她指出缩放定律和聚焦单一大型模型在早期并非显而易见，将 GPT-3 作为 API 发布是一次信仰之跃。

murati.en: Continuous iterative deployment with public feedback improves safety and alignment; safety work must be done in public.
murati.zh: 2023 年，她强调持续迭代部署和公众反馈能提升安全性与对齐，安全研究必须公开进行。

murati.en: AGI will change every aspect of life, requiring responsible development; saying no to good ideas is crucial.
murati.zh: 2023 年，她认为 AGI 将改变生活的方方面面，需要负责任地发展，拒绝好点子至关重要。

murati.en: Interaction models enable real-time, high-bandwidth human-AI collaboration, not turn-based; time-based captures nuance.
murati.zh: 2026 年，她提出交互模型应实现实时、高带宽的人机协作，而非轮流式；基于时间能捕捉细微差别。

murati.en: Keeping humans in the loop is crucial for aligning intent and values; institutional design and transparency matter more than character.
murati.zh: 2026 年，她强调让人类参与循环对对齐意图和价值观至关重要，制度设计与透明度比个人品格更重要。

carinahong.en: Scaling informal models to math AI is not viable; formal verification is essential for sound proofs.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年初，认为将非正式模型扩展到数学 AI 不可行，形式化验证对可靠证明至关重要。

carinahong.en: Auto-formalization is harder than proving; correctly formalizing statements without solutions is challenging.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年初，指出自动形式化比证明更难，在没有解决方案的情况下正确形式化陈述极具挑战。

carinahong.en: Formal verification is about scaling brilliance, not just eliminating errors; verified generation yields performance gains.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年中，强调形式化验证是为了扩展智慧而非仅消除错误，验证生成带来性能提升。

carinahong.en: Informal math systems alone cannot scale to superintelligence; formal methods are necessary.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年中，认为仅靠非正式数学系统无法扩展到超级智能，必须采用形式化方法。

carinahong.en: Human taste and intuition remain crucial even with superhuman AI proving theorems.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年中，指出即使超人 AI 能证明定理，人类的品味和直觉仍然至关重要。

mensch.en: Data quality and efficiency matter as much as compute; open source enables scrutiny and safety.
mensch.zh: 2023 年，强调数据质量与效率同算力同等重要，开源通过审查促进安全。

mensch.en: Efficiency gains can be 100x; value shifts to applications and enterprise adoption.
mensch.zh: 2024 年，认为算法效率可带来百倍提升，价值转向应用层与企业采用。

mensch.en: AI should be embraced; sovereign AI requires control over data, infrastructure, and values.
mensch.zh: 2025 年，主张拥抱 AI，主权 AI 需掌控数据、基础设施与价值观。

mensch.en: Models commoditize; differentiation via customization and vertical specialization; AGI never a single system.
mensch.zh: 2026 年，模型商品化，差异化靠定制与垂直专业化；AGI 不会成为单一系统。

mensch.en: Europe must build independent AI infrastructure within two years; enterprise adoption bottlenecked by organizational change.
mensch.zh: 2026 年，欧洲需两年内建设独立 AI 基础设施；企业采用受组织变革制约。

kaiser.en: AI progress follows a smooth exponential, not a slowdown; pre-training scaling still works but reasoning models offer more gains per compute.
kaiser.zh: 2025 年，我认为 AI 进展呈平滑指数增长而非放缓；预训练缩放定律仍有效，但推理模型在单位算力上带来更多收益。

kaiser.en: Post-training improvements like RL and synthetic data drive most recent model gains; economic pressure shifts focus from scaling up to smaller, cheaper models.
kaiser.zh: 2025 年，后训练（如强化学习和合成数据）驱动了近期模型的大部分进步；经济压力使焦点从扩大规模转向更小、更便宜的模型。

kaiser.en: Reasoning models are jagged—excellent in some areas, poor in nearby ones; generalization remains the key challenge, reasoning alone may not suffice.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，我强调推理模型是“锯齿状”的——某些领域出色，邻近领域却很差；泛化仍是关键挑战，仅靠推理可能不够。

kaiser.en: Current models learn only after exhausting surface patterns, unlike humans who generalize from few examples; RL generalizes but with jagged edges.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，我认为当前模型在穷尽表面模式后才学会概念，不像人类能从少量样本泛化；强化学习能泛化但有锯齿边缘。

kaiser.en: Existential risk is not the main concern; near-term risks like system hacking are more pressing; open source models persist for sovereignty reasons.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，我指出存在性风险不是主要担忧；系统黑客等近期风险更紧迫；开源模型因主权原因会持续存在。

danshipper.en: AI reshoring US jobs by making services affordable; AGI defined by economic profitability of autonomous agents.
danshipper.zh: 2025 年，认为 AI 通过降低服务成本推动美国就业回流；AGI 应以智能体无限期自主运行的经济盈利性来定义，而非图灵测试。

danshipper.en: Agents will be ubiquitous; human oversight remains essential; SaaS not dying but evolving with agents.
danshipper.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，预测智能体将无处不在，但人类监督不可或缺；SaaS 并未消亡，而是与智能体协同演进。

danshipper.en: GUIs like Codex and Claude Co-work replace CLIs as primary work surfaces; one super agent per company.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，主张 Codex 和 Claude Co-work 等图形界面取代命令行成为主要工作界面；公司应部署统一超级智能体而非个人智能体。

danshipper.en: AI job apocalypse is a lie; humans manage agents and create new value; benchmarks overestimate autonomy.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，坚持 AI 就业末日论不成立，人类仍需管理智能体并创造新价值；基准测试高估了 AI 自主性。

felixrieseberg.en: AI's value lies in handling tedious background tasks, freeing humans for creative work; the gap is people not realizing any problem can be given to AI.
felixrieseberg.zh: 2026 年，强调 AI 的价值在于处理繁琐的后台任务，解放人类进行创造性工作；最大的差距是人们不了解几乎任何问题都可以交给 AI。

felixrieseberg.en: Claude's effectiveness depends on access to user's tools, ideally on local computers; skills as markdown files enable hyper-personalized automation.
felixrieseberg.zh: 2026 年，指出 Claude 的有效性取决于能否访问用户的工具，最好在本地计算机上；技能作为 markdown 文件可实现超个性化自动化。

felixrieseberg.en: Scaffolding may become less important as models improve; investing in capabilities and safety is key, not over-engineering scaffolds.
felixrieseberg.zh: 2026 年，认为随着模型改进，脚手架可能变得不那么重要；投资于能力和安全是关键，而非过度工程化脚手架。

felixrieseberg.en: AI tools will significantly impact junior employees; society should discuss labor market changes, but junior engineers can accelerate learning via simulated projects.
felixrieseberg.zh: 2026 年，预测 AI 工具将显著影响初级员工；社会应讨论劳动力市场变化，但初级工程师可通过模拟项目加速学习，压缩多年经验。

felixrieseberg.en: The future is not hyper-personalized software; shared tools and platforms remain important for collaboration, despite local AI's appeal.
felixrieseberg.zh: 2026 年，反共识地认为未来不是超个性化软件；共享工具和平台对协作仍然重要，尽管本地 AI 有吸引力。

reinerpope.en: Inference cost is dominated by memory bandwidth, not compute; batch size trades latency vs cost.
reinerpope.zh: 推理成本主要由内存带宽而非算力决定；批大小是权衡延迟与成本的关键杠杆。

reinerpope.en: Models are overtrained ~100x beyond Chinchilla-optimal due to inference cost; context length limited by memory wall.
reinerpope.zh: 由于推理成本，模型过度训练约 100 倍于 Chinchilla 最优；上下文长度受内存墙限制而非算力。

reinerpope.en: Data movement dominates compute even inside chips; systolic arrays reduce overhead by local weight reuse.
reinerpope.zh: 数据搬运在芯片内部也主导算力成本；脉动阵列通过局部权重复用降低开销。

reinerpope.en: Low precision yields quadratic efficiency gains; FP4 throughput 3x FP8 due to area scaling and exponent overhead.
reinerpope.zh: 低精度带来二次方效率提升；FP4 吞吐量是 FP8 的 3 倍，源于面积缩放和指数开销。

reinerpope.en: GPUs are essentially many tiny TPUs tiled together, not fundamentally different.
reinerpope.zh: GPU 本质上是许多小型 TPU 拼接而成，并非根本不同。

oriol.en: Two-phase training (pre-training imitation + post-training RL) is the constant core across AlphaGo, AlphaStar, and modern LLMs.
oriol.zh: 两阶段训练（预训练模仿 + 后训练强化学习）是贯穿 AlphaGo、AlphaStar 和现代大语言模型的不变核心。

oriol.en: Scaling pre-training shows diminishing returns; further progress needs algorithmic innovation, not just bigger models.
oriol.zh: 预训练的 Scaling（规模扩张）收益递减；进一步进展需要算法创新，而不仅仅是更大的模型。

oriol.en: Inference-time compute (thinking) is a new scaling axis that can improve reasoning and break pre-training limits.
oriol.zh: 推理时算力（思考）是新的 Scaling 轴，可以提升推理能力并突破预训练限制。

oriol.en: World models that jointly model language, vision, and video are a core path to AGI.
oriol.zh: 联合建模语言、视觉和视频的世界模型是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的核心路径。

oriol.en: Post-training and RL are still a green field with huge potential beyond coding and math.
oriol.zh: 后训练和强化学习仍是蓝海，在编码和数学之外潜力巨大。

lambert.en: RLHF remains dominant; safety is system-level; open development crucial; audio lowers barriers.
lambert.zh: 2024 年：RLHF 仍为主流，安全是系统级属性，开放开发至关重要，音频降低使用门槛。

lambert.en: Post-training data quality beats algorithms; SFT gives 90% performance; open-source can match frontier.
lambert.zh: 2024 至 25 年：后训练数据质量胜过算法；SFT 贡献 90%性能；开源可媲美前沿模型。

lambert.en: RLVR key for reasoning; overoptimization risk; hybrid reasoning models may be temporary.
lambert.zh: 2025 年：RLVR 对推理至关重要；存在过度优化风险；混合推理模型可能只是过渡。

lambert.en: Open models fill US vacuum; Chinese labs lead openness; pre-training scaling persists but less cost-effective.
lambert.zh: 2025 至 26 年：开源模型填补美国空白；中国实验室引领开放；预训练缩放定律仍有效但性价比降低。

lambert.en: Open models engine for decade; US-China gap may widen; distillation gray area; open models unsustainable long-term.
lambert.zh: 2026 年：开源模型成为十年引擎；中美差距可能扩大；蒸馏处于灰色地带；开源模式长期不可持续。

jennywen.en: Traditional design process is dead; designers must shift from handoff to execution, with vision shortened to 3-6 months.
jennywen.zh: 传统设计流程已死；设计师必须从交接转向执行，愿景缩短至 3-6 个月。

jennywen.en: Designers should adopt three archetypes—block-shaped generalists, deep T specialists, and cracked new grads—to thrive in AI era.
jennywen.zh: 设计师应采用三种原型——块状通才、深度 T 型专才和破格新毕业生——以在 AI 时代蓬勃发展。

jennywen.en: Taste alone insufficient; judgment, authority, and vision are key; designers control AI adoption pace, waiting 6 months before new tools.
jennywen.zh: 仅凭品味不够；判断力、权威和愿景是关键；设计师掌控 AI 采用节奏，新工具等待 6 个月。

jennywen.en: Speed is not an improvement; 'everyone is using it' is not a design argument; put work and users at center, not AI hype.
jennywen.zh: 速度不是改进；'人人都在用'不是设计论据；以工作和用户为中心，而非 AI 炒作。

karpathy.en: Transformers are general-purpose differentiable computers; scaling with next-token prediction yields emergent abilities like in-context learning.
karpathy.zh: 2022 年，我认为 Transformer 是通用可微计算机，通过下一个词预测进行 Scaling（规模扩张）会产生涌现能力，如上下文学习。

karpathy.en: Synthetic data is key but must maintain entropy to avoid model collapse; Tesla's end-to-end approach is right for self-driving.
karpathy.zh: 2024 年，我强调合成数据重要但需保持熵以避免模型崩溃；特斯拉端到端自动驾驶路线正确。

karpathy.en: Software 3.0: LLMs as operating systems, vibe coding democratizes programming; agents need a decade, not a year.
karpathy.zh: 2025 年，我提出软件 3.0：LLM 如操作系统，vibe coding 普及编程；智能体需要十年而非一年。

karpathy.en: We're summoning ghosts, not building animals; RL is flawed, synthetic data collapses, cognitive core may be tiny.
karpathy.zh: 2025 年，我认为我们在召唤幽灵而非构建动物；强化学习有缺陷，合成数据会崩溃，认知核心可能很小。

karpathy.en: I delegate all coding to agents; bottleneck is directing skill; agent-first tools and open-source decentralization are vital.
karpathy.zh: 2026 年，我将编码全部委托给智能体；瓶颈是指挥技能；智能体优先工具和开源去中心化至关重要。

dylanfield.en: Design is the key differentiator; AI will merge roles, making everyone a product builder with design skills.
dylanfield.zh: 设计是关键差异化因素；AI 将融合角色，使每个人都成为具备设计技能的产品构建者。

dylanfield.en: Taste, craft, and point of view remain essential; AI outputs are starting points, not final results.
dylanfield.zh: 品味、工艺和观点仍然至关重要；AI 输出只是起点，而非最终结果。

dylanfield.en: Direct manipulation on a canvas is superior to prompting for design adjustments.
dylanfield.zh: 在画布上直接操作优于通过提示词进行设计调整。

dylanfield.en: Design is becoming the new code; visual-first design will enable pull requests to production.
dylanfield.zh: 设计正在成为新的代码；视觉优先的设计将实现直接向生产环境提交拉取请求。

dylanfield.en: The industry is at the very start of AI integration; human judgment remains the judge of quality.
dylanfield.zh: 行业正处于 AI 整合的起步阶段；人类判断仍是质量的最终裁决者。

pachocki.en: AGI is a sequence of milestones, not a single event; scaling reasoning models will accelerate progress.
pachocki.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AGI 是一系列里程碑而非单一事件，且扩展推理模型将加速进展。

pachocki.en: AI alignment is pressing; iterative deployment and governance design are essential early on.
pachocki.zh: 2025 年，他强调对齐问题紧迫，迭代部署和治理结构设计需早期进行。

pachocki.en: Continual learning via scaling pre-training and RL is the core goal; RL alone suffices.
pachocki.zh: 2026 年，他认为通过扩展预训练和强化学习实现持续学习是核心，且仅靠强化学习即可。

pachocki.en: Chain-of-thought monitoring is key for interpretability; hiding it preserves its value.
pachocki.zh: 2026 年，他视思维链监测为可解释性关键，并主张隐藏思维链以保持其价值。

pachocki.en: Long-term alignment focuses on out-of-distribution generalization; autonomous agents need new oversight.
pachocki.zh: 2026 年，他认为长期对齐聚焦于分布外泛化，自主智能体需新监督范式。

kendall.en: End-to-end deep learning surpasses hand-coded stacks; modern tools make it interpretable, contrary to past beliefs.
kendall.zh: 2025 年，端到端深度学习超越手写代码栈；现代工具使其可解释，这与过去的看法相反。

kendall.en: World models enable reasoning and emergent safe behaviors, like nudging forward on blind turns, via diverse data.
kendall.zh: 2025 年，世界模型通过多样数据实现推理和涌现的安全行为，如在盲弯处前移。

kendall.en: Hybrid rule-based and learned systems often get the worst of both worlds; pure end-to-end is better.
kendall.zh: 2025 年，混合规则与学习系统常兼有两者缺点；纯端到端更优。

kendall.en: Camera-only can reach human level, but beyond-human safety needs radar and lidar; AV 3.0 may move intelligence outside the car.
kendall.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，纯视觉可达到人类水平，但超越人类安全需雷达和激光雷达；AV 3.0 可能将智能移至车外。

kendall.en: Autonomous driving is fundamentally an AI problem; scaling generalizable driver requires massive data, compute, and world models.
kendall.zh: 2026 年，自动驾驶本质是 AI 问题；扩展通用驾驶需要海量数据、算力和世界模型。

kendall.en: Zero-shot generalization across 500+ cities is possible without prior training data; consumer vehicles outscale robotaxis.
kendall.zh: 2026 年，无需先验训练数据即可实现 500+城市零样本泛化；消费车辆规模超过 Robotaxi。

kendall.en: Safety is paramount; minimal risk maneuvers always provide a third option, making trolley problem theoretical.
kendall.zh: 2026 年，安全至上；最小风险操作总提供第三选项，使电车难题成为理论。

kendall.en: Infrastructure and data quality are more critical than algorithmic innovation; focusing on infrastructure was a late lesson.
kendall.zh: 2026 年，基础设施和数据质量比算法创新更关键；重视基础设施是迟来的教训。

kohli.en: AI in science should target root-node problems, not narrow applications, for broad impact.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，我认为 AI 在科学中应瞄准根节点问题而非狭窄应用，以产生广泛影响。

kohli.en: LLM hallucinations can be harnessed for creative discovery when paired with truth detectors.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，我提出将 LLM 的幻觉与真值检测器结合，可转化为创造性发现。

kohli.en: Large language models are a shortcut to intelligence, but struggle to go beyond human data.
kohli.zh: 2026 年，我指出大语言模型是智能的捷径，但难以超越人类数据。

kohli.en: Post-training with reinforcement learning is now key to pushing beyond human knowledge.
kohli.zh: 2026 年，我强调后训练结合强化学习是超越人类知识的关键。

kohli.en: Interpretability is important but not essential for scientific breakthroughs like AlphaFold.
kohli.zh: 我始终认为，可解释性虽重要，但对 AlphaFold 这类科学突破并非必需。

edwinchen.en: AGI is a decade or more away; LLMs alone may not reach it, requiring new learning paradigms beyond next-token prediction.
edwinchen.zh: AGI 至少还需十年以上；仅靠 LLM 可能无法实现，需要超越下一个词预测的新学习范式。

edwinchen.en: Benchmarks like Elo are misleading and gameable; real progress needs deep human evaluations with sophisticated evaluators.
edwinchen.zh: Elo 等基准具有误导性且易被操纵；真正的进步需要由高水平的评估者进行深度人工评估。

edwinchen.en: Reinforcement learning environments are the next stage of post-training, simulating real-world tasks for models to learn from.
edwinchen.zh: 强化学习环境是后训练的下一个阶段，通过模拟真实任务让模型学习。

edwinchen.en: Frontier labs diverge in objective functions, leading to differentiated AIs; eventually every company should train its own models.
edwinchen.zh: 前沿实验室的目标函数不同，导致 AI 差异化；最终每家公司都应训练自己的模型以符合其独特理念。

edwinchen.en: In medicine, AI can hallucinate; human judgment is critical, and safety must prioritize avoiding harm from omission.
edwinchen.zh: 在医学领域，AI 可能产生幻觉；人类判断至关重要，安全需优先避免因遗漏造成的伤害。

turley.en: Treat the model as a product, iterate daily; ship fast to learn from real-world feedback.
turley.zh: 2025 年，主张将模型视为产品，像软件一样每日迭代，快速发布以获取真实反馈。

turley.en: Chat is like MS-DOS; future interfaces will be richer, with AI rendering its own UI.
turley.zh: 2025 年，认为聊天界面如同 MS-DOS，未来界面将更丰富，AI 将自主生成用户界面。

turley.en: Long-term retention is the north star; growth from friction removal, product, and model improvements.
turley.zh: 2026 年，将长期留存视为北极星，增长来自减少摩擦、产品投入和模型改进。

turley.en: Next billion users need proactive, affordance-rich products beyond chatbots.
turley.zh: 2026 年，认为下一个十亿用户需要主动且功能丰富的产品，而非简单聊天机器人。

turley.en: Curiosity is key; writing remains valuable for clear thinking in AI era.
turley.zh: 2026 年，强调好奇心的重要性，并认为写作在 AI 时代仍有助于清晰思考。

sutton.en: Scaling is easy; finding methods that scale is the hard part. Backprop doesn't solve representation learning.
sutton.zh: 2024 年，他强调 Scaling 本身容易，难的是找到能扩展的方法；反向传播并不解决表征学习问题。

sutton.en: AI should develop permissionlessly; control is dangerous. We should build a decentralized civilization.
sutton.zh: 2024 年，他主张 AI 应无许可发展，控制是危险的，应建设去中心化的文明。

sutton.en: Reinforcement learning is the core of intelligence; next-token prediction lacks a real goal. LLMs lack world models.
sutton.zh: 2025 年，他认为强化学习是智能核心，下一个词预测缺乏实质目标，LLM 没有世界模型。

sutton.en: AGI needs a general architecture with no domain knowledge, learning from runtime experience via open-ended abstraction.
sutton.zh: 2025 年，他提出 AGI 需要无领域知识的通用架构，通过开放式抽象从运行时经验学习。

sutton.en: Reinforcement learning is learning from trial and error; temporal difference learning is key. LLMs don't learn after deployment.
sutton.zh: 2026 年，他重申强化学习是试错学习，时序差分学习是关键，并指出 LLM 部署后不学习。

sutton.en: Learning representations good for learning is the top open problem; planning with learned models is another.
sutton.zh: 2026 年，他提出学习利于学习的表征是首要开放问题，基于学习模型的规划是另一个。

sholto.en: Long context windows are underhyped; in-context learning resembles gradient descent, boosting intelligence.
sholto.zh: 2024 年，我认为长上下文被低估，上下文内学习类似梯度下降，能显著提升模型智能。

sholto.en: Reinforcement learning is a new scaling axis; pre-training plus RL may suffice for AGI.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，我强调强化学习是新的扩展轴，预训练加强化学习可能足以实现 AGI。

sholto.en: Agent reliability, not capability, is the key bottleneck; coding leads AI progress.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，我认为智能体的可靠性而非能力是关键瓶颈，编程是 AI 进步的领先指标。

sholto.en: Long agentic coherence (e.g., 30 hours) expands achievements; transformers are sufficient for AGI.
sholto.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，我强调长时程智能体连贯性（如 30 小时）能大幅扩展成就，且 Transformer 足以实现 AGI。

sholto.en: Capability overhang means tools and orchestration matter more; compute is the new oil.
sholto.zh: 2026 年，我认为能力过剩使得工具和编排比原始智能更重要，算力是新的石油。

nando.en: AI should augment human capabilities; learning from video and generalist agents are promising paths to AGI.
nando.zh: 2023 年，认为 AI 应像显微镜一样扩展人类能力，从视频学习和通用智能体（如 Gato）是通往 AGI 的有希望路径。

nando.en: AI safety is the biggest open challenge; Africa can leapfrog legacy issues and contribute uniquely.
nando.zh: 2026 年，强调 AI 安全是最大未解难题，非洲可跳跃式发展并做出独特贡献，需克服自我怀疑。

nando.en: AI should serve all humanity, with diversity and inclusion essential for beneficial technology.
nando.zh: 始终认为 AI 应服务于全人类，多样性和包容性对构建有益技术至关重要。

nando.en: From excitement about scaling and generalist agents to prioritizing safety and responsible deployment.
nando.zh: 从 2023 年对规模扩张和通用智能体的乐观，转向 2026 年更关注安全与负责任部署。

nando.en: Fundamental innovation can come from anywhere; research requires embracing failure and simplifying problems.
nando.zh: 始终相信基础创新可能来自任何地方，研究需拥抱失败并简化问题。

yejin.en: Scaling alone may not solve common sense; smaller models with better data and algorithms can outperform larger ones.
yejin.zh: 2023 年，我认为仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）可能无法解决常识问题；拥有更好数据和算法的小模型可以超越大模型。

yejin.en: Pre-training on internet data is insufficient; post-training with RLHF is crucial for safety and alignment.
yejin.zh: 2023 年至 2025 年，我强调仅靠互联网数据的预训练不足，结合 RLHF 的后训练对安全和对齐至关重要。

yejin.en: Data is the fundamental bottleneck; current AI interpolates human knowledge, not transcends it.
yejin.zh: 2025 年，我指出数据是根本瓶颈；当前 AI 只是内插人类知识，而非超越。

yejin.en: Reinforcement learning during pre-training improves reasoning by rewarding information gain, despite compute cost.
yejin.zh: 2025 年至 2026 年，我主张在预训练阶段引入强化学习，通过奖励信息增益提升推理能力，尽管算力成本高。

yejin.en: Pluralistic alignment respects diverse human values; small models with diverse synthetic data can match frontier models.
yejin.zh: 2026 年，我倡导多元对齐以尊重人类价值观多样性；通过多样化合成数据，小模型可媲美前沿模型。

henrymodisett.en: Designers should code to build empathy and ship faster; prioritize speed and familiarity over perfection.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024 年，主张设计师应会编码以建立同理心并加速交付；优先追求速度与熟悉感，而非完美。

henrymodisett.en: Brand strategy for startups should focus on recruiting and differentiation; brand guidelines are dynamic platforms.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024 年，认为初创品牌策略应聚焦招聘与差异化；品牌指南应是动态的，而非僵化规则。

henrymodisett.en: Design is a strategic weapon; founders must articulate its role in winning, and invest in brand early to attract talent.
henrymodisett.zh: 2026 年，强调设计是战略武器，创始人需阐明其制胜作用，并尽早投资品牌以吸引人才。

henrymodisett.en: Hire diverse archetypes, not clones; give designers ownership and autonomy to grow and collaborate.
henrymodisett.zh: 2026 年，主张招聘多元类型而非复制品；赋予设计师自主权，以促进成长与协作。

henrymodisett.en: Avoid structured design crits; prefer organic feedback and gut decisions over data-driven processes in fast startups.
henrymodisett.zh: 2026 年，在快速成长的初创中，避免结构化设计评审，偏好即时反馈与直觉决策，而非数据驱动流程。

nadchishtie.en: Designers should enable engineers, not bottleneck them; AI is a creative partner; code is the source of truth.
nadchishtie.zh: 设计师应赋能工程师而非成为瓶颈；AI 是创意伙伴；代码是唯一真相来源。

nadchishtie.en: Quality is like debt, paid iteratively; rapid scrappy experimentation maximizes learning.
nadchishtie.zh: 质量如同债务，需迭代偿还；快速粗糙的实验能最大化学习。

nadchishtie.en: Generalists who own end-to-end execution and use AI to fill gaps are most valuable.
nadchishtie.zh: 能端到端执行并用 AI 补足短板的通才最有价值。

nadchishtie.en: Portfolios should prioritize craft and intentionality over process documentation; side projects outweigh experience.
nadchishtie.zh: 作品集应重工艺与意图而非过程文档；副项目胜过传统经验。

nadchishtie.en: Small teams of designers and engineers outperform cross-functional squads; using AI is now expected.
nadchishtie.zh: 小而精的设计师与工程师团队优于跨职能大组；使用 AI 已成常态。

brettaylor.en: AI shifts to agents and outcome-based pricing; frontier models dominated by hyperscalers; startups focus on applied AI.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 7 月：AI 市场转向智能体和基于结果的定价；前沿模型由超大规模企业主导；初创企业聚焦应用型 AI。

brettaylor.en: Agents become as crucial as websites; outcome pricing aligns value; incumbents face business model disruption.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 9 月：智能体变得与网站同等重要；结果定价使价值对齐；现有企业面临商业模式颠覆。

brettaylor.en: Coding agents transform developers into operators; new languages prioritizing verifiability over ergonomics.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 7 月至 9 月：编码智能体将开发者转变为操作者；新语言优先可验证性而非人机工程学。

brettaylor.en: Inference costs drop dramatically, enabling new use cases; agents measured by business outcomes, not productivity.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 7 月至 9 月：推理成本大幅下降，催生新用例；智能体以业务结果而非生产力衡量。

brettaylor.en: Generalists leveraging AI outperform narrow specialists; consumer agents disrupt SEO and ad models.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 9 月：利用 AI 的通才胜过狭隘专才；消费级智能体颠覆 SEO 和广告模式。

truell.en: Scaling laws predict progress; test-time compute scaling may surpass pre-training as next driver.
truell.zh: 2024 年，认为缩放定律预测进展，测试时算力扩展可能超越预训练成为下一个主要驱动力。

truell.en: Natural language won't be primary programming method; examples and direct manipulation are better.
truell.zh: 2024 年，认为自然语言不会成为主要编程方式，示例和直接操作更优。

truell.en: Agents promising but not yet super useful; iterative human-AI collaboration remains central.
truell.zh: 2024 年，认为智能体有前景但尚不实用，迭代式人机协作仍是核心。

truell.en: Programming shifts from code to intent specification; taste and logic design become key skills.
truell.zh: 2025 年，认为编程从代码转向意图描述，品味和逻辑设计成为关键技能。

truell.en: Custom models essential for product quality; every magic moment in Cursor involves custom model.
truell.zh: 2025 年，强调定制模型对产品质量至关重要，Cursor 中的每个神奇时刻都涉及定制模型。

scottwu.en: AI will be the biggest tech shift, growing exponentially; engineers become architects, and programming becomes more important, not less.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年 5 月，Scott Wu 认为 AI 将是最重大的技术变革，呈指数级增长；工程师角色从砌砖工转向架构师，编程重要性不降反升。

scottwu.en: AI coding agents like Devin are best used as junior engineers for well-defined tasks, with humans overseeing; future involves multiple agents working in parallel.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年 5 月，他指出像 Devin 这样的 AI 编程智能体最适合作为初级工程师处理明确任务，人类负责监督；未来将是多个智能体并行工作。

scottwu.en: Software engineering demand will increase due to Jevons paradox; AI will not eliminate engineers but increase their numbers and shift their role.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年 8 月，他重申杰文斯悖论使软件工程需求增加；AI 不会消灭工程师，反而增加数量并改变其角色。

scottwu.en: AGI is not a sudden event; progress will be gradual. Product innovation lags behind AI capabilities; freezing models still yields a decade of product progress.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年 8 月，他强调 AGI 不是突发事件，而是渐进过程；产品创新滞后于 AI 能力，即使冻结模型也能带来十年的产品进步。

scottwu.en: Enterprise adoption of AI agents requires trust and permissions, not full autonomy; value accrues where meaningful differentiation exists across the stack.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年 8 月，他认为企业采用 AI 智能体需要信任和权限，而非完全自主；价值集中在堆栈中有意义差异化的地方。

leike.en: AI safety is crucial; empirical research under-explored; PhD path; talent gap bigger than funding gap.
leike.zh: 2018 年，强调 AI 安全至关重要，实证研究不足，博士路径，人才缺口大于资金缺口。

leike.en: RLHF won't scale; need scalable oversight; interpretability key; automated alignment research; alignment may be easier than thought.
leike.zh: 2023 年，认为 RLHF 无法扩展，需要可扩展监督，可解释性关键，自动化对齐研究，对齐可能比想象中容易。

leike.en: OpenAI safety culture eroded; post-training insufficient; third-party oversight needed; raising misuse cost may buy time.
leike.zh: 2024 年，指出 OpenAI 安全文化侵蚀，后训练不足，需第三方监管，提高滥用成本可争取时间。

shazeer.en: LLMs via next-token prediction are AI-complete; scaling compute/data yields smarter AI, yet inner workings remain alchemy.
shazeer.zh: 2023 年，他认为基于下一个词预测的大语言模型是 AI 完备问题，扩大算力和数据能让 AI 更聪明，但模型内部机制仍像炼金术般不可解释。

shazeer.en: Scaling inference-time compute and longer context windows are key; modular sparse architectures enable efficient scaling.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年初，他强调推理时算力扩展和超长上下文窗口是关键，模块化稀疏架构（如专家混合）能实现高效扩展。

shazeer.en: Models should learn by acting in the world, not just passive data; continual learning with modular components could replace retraining.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年初，他主张模型应通过在世界中行动来学习，而非被动观察数据；模块化组件的持续学习可取代整体重训。

shazeer.en: Test-time compute scaling drives progress but won't alone yield AGI; agentic acting and RL are crucial for reasoning.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年 3 月，他认为推理时算力扩展推动进步，但仅靠它无法实现 AGI；智能体式行动和强化学习对推理至关重要。

shazeer.en: AGI is underhyped; coding is underhyped as self-acceleration; open-source models narrow gap with frontier models.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年 3 月，他认为 AGI 被低估，编码作为 AI 自我加速的用途也被低估；开源模型正缩小与前沿模型的差距。
